page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-48 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs built on the arm64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. There are zero graphics processing units (GPUs) bundled with this instance, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Utilizing the arm64 architecture provides a resource-dense profile with favorable power-to-performance characteristics. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel compute or local NVMe storage. However, the lack of local storage and GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, limiting its utility for direct high-speed local disk operations or hardware-accelerated machine learning tasks.

The hardware profile of the c4a-highmem-48 makes it suitable for memory-intensive applications, including medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise application servers, and data processing pipelines that require significant memory capacity without requiring high-performance local storage.
